footnote_text: These shares of Class A Common Stock ("Class A Shares") were held by a trust of which the Reporting Person was a co-trustee and, in that capacity, he may have been deemed to share voting and dispositive power over these Class A Shares with the other trustee. However, the Reporting Person did not have a pecuniary interest in, and he disclaimed beneficial ownership of, these Class A Shares. On November 19, 2026, the trust made a donation of these 7,022 Class A Shares to a charitable organization.
